WOW Wipes.

Ecommerce Photography and Videos

Start a project More of our work

WOW Wipes offer a range of antibacterial bulk wipes solutions. Jarred and Rob completed significant R&D to develop a superior range of bulk wet wipe roles and dispensers.

These wipes soon became the fitness industries first choice to improve member experience and hygiene. Since dominating this space, WOW Wipes have expanded into corporate offices, including the Commonwealth Bank head office located in Sydney and most recently with leading supermarket giant Aldi nation-wide.

WOW Wipes has grown exponentially over the last 10 years. It is a credit to their dedication, high standards and ongoing mission to deliver the best product and service for their clients. Always.

Pepper has had the pleasure of working with WOW Wipes to create ongoing video and photo content that aligns and supports their digital marketing strategy.
